title: Concept: Predictable randomness via math.random (lua) — review required
description: In lua, math.random is a statistical generator, not a cryptographic one: observing outputs reveals the state, and default seeds repeat across runs. Security values need unpredictability, which only a CSPRNG binding provides in lua.
applicability: lua codebases drawing random values through math.random; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Guessed session tokens, reset links, and nonces when predictable output guards access; MEDIUM severity, HIGH when the value directly authenticates.
